_comment: OpenAI API public list prices (standard tier), USD per 1M tokens, for Codex CLI cost estimates. cacheRead is the cached-input rate (10% of input for GPT-5 family). cacheWrite is 0: OpenAI prompt caching is implicit with no write fee. Matched by family substring in pricing.js, most-specific first. Update from https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing when prices change.
